text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: How do I get an audience with the king?
zh: 我要怎样才能觐见国王？

text: I need access to the library.
zh: 我需要进入图书馆。

text: I want to pay the fee to access the library.
zh: 我想付费进入图书馆。

text: What do you know about Dhul'oq?
zh: 你对杜尔奥克了解多少？

text: I need a permit to access the Marin Passage.
zh: 我需要一张进入马林通道的通行证。

text: Cornelia, the overseer, is a traitor.
zh: 监工科妮莉亚是个叛徒。

text: Marvin sold fake academy wine.
zh: 马文卖过假的学院葡萄酒。

text: Thorald has been causing trouble at Rair's Inn.
zh: 索拉尔德一直在莱尔的旅店闹事。

text: What do you know about the bandits?
zh: 关于强盗你知道些什么？

text: Here's the bandit ring you wanted.
zh: 这是你要的强盗戒指。

text: I want to join the royal guard.
zh: 我想加入皇家卫队。

text: What are my duties as a Royal Guard?
zh: 身为皇家卫队一员，我的职责是什么？

text: Where is the king?
zh: 国王在哪里？

text: I found this bag of the raider chief.
zh: 我找到了掠夺者首领的这个袋子。

text: I have some bandit rings for you.
zh: 我这里有些强盗戒指要给你。

text: I'll come back later.
zh: 我稍后再来。

text: Name's #:Edmon:# - the King's advisor.
zh: 我叫#:埃德蒙:#——国王的顾问。

text: Who are you, if I may ask?
zh: 恕我冒昧，你是哪位？

text:
Very well, ###player.name###.
Is there anything in particular that you need?
zh:
好的，###player.name###。
你有什么特别的需求吗？

text: Very well.
zh: 好的。

text:
You?
Unless you have urgent matter, I am afraid you won't get an audience soon.
zh:
你？
除非你有紧急事务，否则恐怕你短期内见不到国王。

text: It will certainly be enough if you first present your concerns to me.
zh: 你先把你的事务向我陈述，这样就足够了。

text: Is there something specific you are looking for?
zh: 你在找什么特定的东西吗？

text: I am looking for a book about Dhul'oq.
zh: 我在找一本关于杜尔奥克的书。

text: Which books are there in the library?
zh: 图书馆里都有些什么书？

text: I am researching the stone doors.
zh: 我在研究那些石门。

text: Nothing in particular.
zh: 没什么特别的。

text: Maybe you should start with other books first, and not with those from the royal library.
zh: 也许你应该先从别的书读起，而不是王室图书馆里的这些。

text: Alternatively, you may as well pay a small fee to access the library.
zh: 或者，你也可以支付一小笔费用进入图书馆。

text: We mostly have historical books about our beloved Grenmark and the capital.
zh: 我们的藏书大多是关于我们挚爱的格伦马克和王都的历史书籍。

text: Of course you'll also find various other books the king acquired on his journeys to other places.
zh: 当然，你也能找到国王在游历各地时收集的各种其他书籍。

text: I don't know about Dhul'oq, nor a book about it.
zh: 我不知道什么杜尔奥克，也没听说过与之相关的书。

text: So, is there a particular book you are looking for?
zh: 那么，你在找某本特定的书吗？

text: Many of our books are valuable and irreplaceable. A small fee is needed to cover the risk of you flipping the pages a bit too harsh.
zh: 我们的许多藏书都珍贵且无可替代。收取一小笔费用，是为了弥补你翻书太用力带来的风险。

text: The fee to access the library is 250 gold coins.
zh: 进入图书馆的费用是250金币。

text: Here are 250 gold coins.
zh: 这是250金币。

text: I'll come back later.
zh: 我稍后再来。

text: Good.
zh: 好。

text: Perhaps knowledge about this can be found in one of the older books of the library.
zh: 也许在图书馆较古老的藏书中能找到相关的知识。

text:
Thank you very much!
You'll find the library on the upper floor of the throne room.
The stairs leading up are to your left.
zh:
非常感谢！
图书馆就在王座厅的楼上。
上楼的楼梯在你左手边。

text: Whatever Dhul'oq seems to be, it is not something I have heard of.
zh: 不管这个杜尔奥克是什么，我从未听说过。

text: Perhaps knowledge about Dhul'oq can be found in one of the older books of the library.
zh: 也许在图书馆较古老的藏书中能找到关于杜尔奥克的知识。

text: You must mean those sealed ruins that can be found all over the area.
zh: 你说的一定是这一带随处可见的那些被封印的遗迹。

text: A mage from the academy wrote a paper on this. If I remember correctly, the author's name was #:Lyrak:#.
zh: 学院的一位法师就此写过一篇论文。如果我没记错，作者的名字是#:莱拉克:#。

text: The magicians were kind enough to bring us a copy after our king also wanted to know about the ruins.
zh: 在我们的国王也想了解那些遗迹之后，法师们好心地给我们送来了一份副本。

text: For a small fee, you can search for the paper yourself in the library.
zh: 只需一小笔费用，你就可以亲自去图书馆查找那篇论文。

text: The passage is closed off at the moment due to the increased amount of raiders in there.
zh: 由于通道里的掠夺者越来越多，那里目前已被封闭。

text:
Why would you need to access the passage?
Are you perhaps interested in visiting the academy of the mages?
zh:
你为什么需要进入通道？
莫非你有意造访法师学院？

text: A place called Dhul'oq is past the passage.
zh: 通道的另一头有个叫杜尔奥克的地方。

text: Uhm... Yes! I'd like to visit the academy.
zh: 呃……是的！我想去学院看看。

text: Uhm.. Yes! I'd like to visit the academy.
zh: 呃……对！我想去学院看看。

text: For no particular reason.
zh: 没什么特别的原因。

text:
I'm not aware of such a place.
North of the passage, there's only the academy, the harbor, and an old tower.
zh:
我不知道有这样一个地方。
通道以北只有学院、港口和一座旧塔。

text: But if you really want to go through the Marin Passage, I can give you a permit.
zh: 不过如果你真想穿过马林通道，我可以给你一张通行证。

text: For the permit and an official seal, I shall receive 50 gold coins from you.
zh: 通行证连同官方印章，我要向你收取50金币。

text: Ok. Here are 50 gold coins.
zh: 好吧。这是50金币。

text: That's quite a lot.
zh: 这可不便宜。

text:
The 50 gold coins are a simple flat fee that every citizen must pay.
Feel free to come back later when you have the gold.
zh:
这50金币是每位公民都必须支付的统一费用。
等你凑够了金币，随时欢迎再来。

text:
Good.
This will only take a second.
zh:
好。
马上就好。

text: Here, take the permit to access the Marin passage.
zh: 给，拿好这张进入马林通道的通行证。

text: Then may I refer you to the royal guard.
zh: 那么请容我把你引荐给皇家卫队。

text: As far as I know, some other citizens will soon be escorted through the passage by our guards.
zh: 据我所知，很快会有一批市民在我们卫兵的护送下穿过通道。

text:
If you hurry, you can still join them.
They usually wait in front of the #:entrance to the passage:#.
zh:
如果你抓紧时间，还能赶上他们。
他们通常在#:通道入口:#前等候。

text: Then, for your own safety, I will decline your request.
zh: 那么，为了你自己的安全，我将拒绝你的请求。

text: If you think of a good reason later, please feel free to ask me again.
zh: 如果你之后想到了正当的理由，欢迎随时再来找我。

text:
What?!
What do you want to tell me?
zh:
什么？！
你想告诉我什么？

text: She is secretly the leader of the raider.
zh: 她暗中是掠夺者的头目。

text:
I'm shocked.
How could we have been so blind?
zh:
我很震惊。
我们怎么会如此有眼无珠？

text: I, on behalf of the King and the Royal Guard, must express my thanks.
zh: 我谨代表国王和皇家卫队，向你表示感谢。

text: Here, take my ring as a thank you for your efforts.
zh: 来，收下我的戒指，作为对你付出的谢意。

text: We are happy to have you in our ranks.
zh: 我们很高兴有你加入我们的队伍。

text: You would certainly be a valuable member of the ranks of the royal guard.
zh: 你一定会成为皇家卫队中宝贵的一员。

text: If I were you, I would consider joining us.
zh: 如果我是你，我会考虑加入我们。

text: You won't regret your decision.
zh: 你不会后悔这个决定的。

text: I hereby appoint you as an official member of the Royal Guard!
zh: 我在此正式任命你为皇家卫队的一员！

text: You will get your new equipment in the barracks.
zh: 你可以在兵营领取你的新装备。

text:
I've already heard about it.
Hick and I are going to have a conversation about that.
zh:
这件事我已经听说了。
我会和希克好好谈谈的。

text:
You, however, have done a good job in this matter.
That is the attitude I expect from the Royal Guard.
zh:
不过，你在这件事上做得很好。
这正是我期望皇家卫队应有的态度。

text:
Keep up the good work.
We could use someone like you in our ranks.
zh:
继续保持。
我们的队伍正需要你这样的人。

text: Here, this shall be your reward.
zh: 来，这是你的奖赏。

text: I cannot condone your attacking a member of the royal guard.
zh: 我无法容忍你袭击皇家卫队成员的行为。

text: However, we knew that Thorald often causes problems, which does not correspond to the image of the royal guard.
zh: 不过我们也清楚，索拉尔德经常惹是生非，这与皇家卫队的形象不符。

text: Apparently, you were able to convince him to behave like a guard again.
zh: 看来，你成功说服了他重新拿出卫兵该有的样子。

text: The matter between Thorald and Rair seems to have been resolved, but Thorald didn't seem particularly enthusiastic about his return to the barracks.
zh: 索拉尔德和莱尔之间的事似乎已经解决了，但索拉尔德对回到兵营似乎并不怎么热心。

text:
You've acted most like the royal guard in this matter.
Standing up for the citizens is our duty, and for that I must thank you!
zh:
在这件事上，你的所作所为最有皇家卫队的风范。
挺身维护市民是我们的职责，为此我必须感谢你！

text: So you want to put yourself in the king's service?
zh: 这么说，你想为国王效力？

text:
You've proven to us that you have what it takes.
If it's your wish, I'll welcome you into our ranks on behalf of the king.
zh:
你已经向我们证明了自己的实力。
如果这是你的意愿，我将代表国王欢迎你加入我们的队伍。

text: Yes, I want to join the Royal Guard.
zh: 是的，我想加入皇家卫队。

text: I need to think about it.
zh: 我需要考虑一下。

text:
To do that, you must first prove to us that you have what it takes.
A Royal Guard serves the king, but above all, the citizens.
zh:
要加入卫队，你必须先向我们证明你有这个实力。
皇家卫队为国王效力，但更重要的是为市民服务。

text: How can I prove myself?
zh: 我要如何证明自己？

text: I'll be back later.
zh: 我稍后再来。

text: Such an important decision should not be made carelessly.
zh: 如此重要的决定不该草率做出。

text: Once you become a guard, other groups will no longer accept you.
zh: 一旦你成为卫兵，其他势力就不会再接纳你了。

text: Bandits are gathering outside the walls, making the streets unsafe for everyone here in Grenmark.
zh: 强盗在城墙外聚集，让格伦马克的街道对所有人来说都不再安全。

text: If you bring me a #:Bandit Ring:#, it shows me that you are both skilled in combat and capable of serving the king and the citizens.
zh: 如果你能给我带来一枚#:强盗戒指:#，就足以证明你既善于战斗，又有能力为国王和市民效力。

text:
Good!
One day you'll be a Royal Guard if you behave like one.
zh:
很好！
只要你拿出皇家卫队的样子，总有一天你会成为其中一员。

text: Let me see...
zh: 让我看看……

text:
Yes, indeed!
It looks like the other rings we've already taken from the bandits.
zh:
没错，正是！
它和我们已经从强盗手里缴获的其他戒指一模一样。

text: You've shown courage, and that speaks volumes. Keep it up, and you'll soon become a member of our guard.
zh: 你展现了勇气，这足以说明一切。继续保持，你很快就能成为卫队的一员。

text: Unfortunately, we had to stop the transports to the academy due to the increasing dangers around the capital.
zh: 遗憾的是，由于王都周边的危险日益增多，我们不得不暂停前往学院的护送。

text: We already know a lot about the incidents with the bandits, but I'm not allowed to tell you everything.
zh: 关于强盗的种种事件，我们已经掌握了很多情况，但我不能全部告诉你。

text: Essentially, the bandits have been a nuisance for too long. They're the reason why the citizens don't want to leave the city unaccompanied by our guards.
zh: 说到底，强盗为患已久。正是因为他们，市民们才不愿在没有卫兵陪同的情况下出城。

text:
Despite the constant efforts of the Royal Guard, some of the bandits continue to roam unpunished.
Unfortunately, we don't know where they come from.
zh:
尽管皇家卫队不懈努力，仍有一些强盗逍遥法外。
遗憾的是，我们不知道他们来自何处。

text: It's also a mystery to us who's leading the bandits. We have some suspicions, but nothing concrete.
zh: 究竟是谁在领导这些强盗，对我们来说也是个谜。我们有一些怀疑对象，但没有确凿的证据。

text: What are your plans regarding the bandits?
zh: 你们打算如何对付这些强盗？

text: As far as I am allowed to tell, we are currently trying to keep the surrounding area safe.
zh: 在我能透露的范围内，我们目前正努力保障周边地区的安全。

text: In the near future, we will send out some patrols and start a large area search.
zh: 不久之后，我们将派出巡逻队，并展开大范围搜索。

text: We hope to get more information about the bandits and a lead to their chief.
zh: 我们希望能获得更多关于强盗的情报，以及指向其首领的线索。

text: That's all I can tell you.
zh: 我能告诉你的就这么多。

text: As a Royal Guard, it is your duty to help the people and support the king.
zh: 身为皇家卫队的一员，帮助人民、辅佐国王是你的职责。

text:
Still, bandits are a major problem for our fellow citizens.
For every bandit ring you bring me, I will reward you accordingly.
zh:
话虽如此，强盗仍是市民们的一大祸患。
你每给我带来一枚强盗戒指，我都会给你相应的奖赏。

text: Also, take this key.
zh: 另外，拿上这把钥匙。

text: As a Royal Guard, you will occasionally be needed in the royal crypt. With this key, you may enter the crypt via the barracks' basement.
zh: 身为皇家卫队的一员，你偶尔会需要前往王室墓穴。有了这把钥匙，你就可以经由兵营的地下室进入墓穴。

text:
Very good!
You've ensured safety on the streets of Grenmark once more!
zh:
非常好！
你再一次守护了格伦马克街道的安全！

text: Is there anything else you need?
zh: 你还需要什么吗？

text: You have already given me the ring of a bandit.
zh: 你已经给过我一枚强盗的戒指了。

text:
I am sure the other guards need your assistance as well.
Keep your eyes open and help them if you can.
zh:
我相信其他卫兵也需要你的协助。
保持警觉，力所能及时帮帮他们。

text:
You found a bag from the chief?
I am impressed!
zh:
你找到了首领的袋子？
真是令我刮目相看！

text: You truly are an excellent member of the Royal Guard.
zh: 你确实是皇家卫队出色的一员。

text: You'd make a fine Royal Guard.
zh: 你会成为一名优秀的皇家卫队成员。

text: If you don't mind, I'll take the bag and bring it to Hick, our quartermaster.
zh: 如果你不介意，我会把袋子收下，交给我们的军需官希克。

text: Here, take the bag.
zh: 给，袋子拿去吧。

text: I'll take it to Hick myself.
zh: 我自己拿去给希克。

text:
Very well.
Don't hesitate and go straight to him.
You'll find Hick in the barracks.
zh:
好的。
那就别耽搁，直接去找他。
希克就在兵营里。

text: Very well.
zh: 好的。

text: This shall be your reward.
zh: 这是你的奖赏。

text: King Weynard III made his way down into the #:crypt:#.
zh: 韦纳德三世国王已经下到#:墓穴:#去了。

text: It seems the raider chief carried an artifact the king has been seeking for quite some time.
zh: 看来掠夺者首领身上带着一件国王寻觅已久的神器。

text: As one of the king's Royal Guard, you are forbidden from pledging yourself to any other faction.
zh: 身为国王的皇家卫队一员，你不得再效忠于任何其他势力。
